name: MeterMesh

capability.summary: Explain one X Layer Testnet transaction and bind the delivery to buyer-controlled metered billing.
capability.input: MeterMesh work.request v1 with an X Layer transaction hash

billing.authorization: buyer signature over a cumulative voucher
billing.rule: Delivery alone cannot increase the amount owed. Rejection creates no voucher increase.
billing.settlement: highest accepted cumulative voucher through OKX MPP escrow on X Layer

permissions: read the public X Layer transaction
send and receive signed MeterMesh envelopes
ask the buyer wallet to sign only after explicit acceptance

capabilityStatus.note: A real X Layer Testnet receipt and provenance path passed live verification.

capabilityStatus.label: Structured AI explanation
capabilityStatus.note: Groq strict structured output passed against a real X Layer Testnet receipt.

capabilityStatus.label: XMTP Node carrier
capabilityStatus.note: A real XMTP dev request, delivery, idempotent resend, keyed restart, and wrong-key failure passed. Buyer browser connection remains pending.

capabilityStatus.label: OKX MPP Testnet mutation
capabilityStatus.note: Read-only authentication is verified. Chain 1952 session mutation support is not yet proven.

explanation.summary: The transaction completed successfully on X Layer Testnet.
explanation.outcome: The called address executed without an EVM-level revert.
limitations: The user intent is not present in the chain facts.
